nodes.title: Responsible AI requires record access
nodes.text: Users must be able to verify AI interactions that affect billing, privacy, memory, tool use, support outcomes, complaints, or automated decisions.

nodes.title: RA Refinery final authority
nodes.text: Drafts from hosted tools or models are candidate material only. Final answers must pass claim extraction, evidence matching, contradiction scan, and completion-language checks.

nodes.title: Airgapped storage mode
nodes.text: Airgapped mode stores graph nodes, chats, settings, and audit logs locally and makes no external model or web calls unless the user changes mode and configures a connector.
